# Finca Guarumo - Off-Grid Eco-Lodge in Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula

## Quick Facts
- **Name**: Finca Guarumo
- **Type**: Sustainable eco-lodge and vacation rental
- **Location**: Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica (6km from Puerto Jiménez, 45 min from Corcovado National Park)
- **Accommodation**: Villa Bruno (54㎡ eco-villa)
- **Capacity**: 2-4 guests (2 bedrooms)
- **Owners**: Katja and Peter Hollaar (Dutch conservationists, established 2023)
- **Specialty**: Off-grid living, wildlife viewing, sustainable tourism, reforestation
- **Languages**: English, Dutch, Russian, Spanish
- **Coordinates**: 8.496420, -83.334145

## Sustainability Features
- **Power**: 100% solar energy system with 3-4 day battery backup
- **Water**: Natural spring water (5x filtered for drinking)
- **Internet**: Starlink satellite Wi-Fi (remote-work capable)
- **Food**: farm-to-table, organic herbs and seasonal fruit from property
- **Waste**: Composting system, minimal plastic, recycling program
- **Conservation**: Active reforestation project (fruit and native forest trees)

## Wildlife & Nature
**Daily Sightings (90%+ probability)**:
- Scarlet macaws (endangered species, breeding pairs visible morning/evening)
- Squirrel monkeys (troops of 10-20)
- White-faced capuchin monkeys
- Chestnut-mandibled toucans
- Carolina (resident brocket deer)
- 200+ bird species on property

**Frequent Visitors**:
- Howler monkeys
- Coatis
- Agoutis
- Anteaters
- Brocket deer
- Various hummingbird species

**Best Viewing Times**: Dawn (5:30-7:30 AM), Dusk (4:30-6:00 PM)

## Villa Bruno Details
- **Size**: 54㎡ (580 sq ft) interior + 28㎡ (150 sq ft) covered terrace
- **Bedrooms**: 2 (queen beds)
- **Bathrooms**: 1 full bathroom with hot water
- **Kitchen**: Fully equipped (induction stove, refrigerator, dual-system drinking/utility filtered water)
- **Living**: Open-concept with panoramic jungle views
- **Outdoor**: Covered terrace, fruit and herbs garden
- **Climate Control**: Portable fans (no A/C needed due to elevation)
- **Screening**: Fully screened windows and doors (bug-free interior)
- **Amenities**: Fresh linens, towels, kitchen starter supplies
- **Tech**: Starlink WiFi, USB charging stations, LED lighting
- **Check-in**: 3:00 PM (flexible)
- **Check-out**: 11:00 AM (flexible)
- **Minimum Stay**: 1 night

## Location & Access
- **From San José**: 6-7 hour drive OR 45-minute flight to Puerto Jiménez
- **From Puerto Jiménez Airport**: 6km (15 minutes), we offer transportation for $15 USD
- **Vehicle Requirements**: Any car (dry season), 4x4 recommended (rainy season May-June, Oct-Nov)
- **Road Conditions**: Unpaved with some rough patches
- **Airport Pickup**: Available for a fee

## Nearby Attractions 
- **Corcovado National Park**: 45 minutes (La Leona entrance)
- **Playa Platanares**: Quiet beach, sunset viewing
- **Cabo Matapalo**: Surfing, tide pools, wildlife
- **Puerto Jiménez**: Town center, restaurants, supermarkets, tours
- **Golfo Dulce**: Kayaking, dolphin watching
- **Osa Wild**: Wildlife rescue center

## Pricing & Booking
- **Rates**: Seasonal (contact for current pricing)
- **Minimum Stay**: 1 night
- **Payment**: Cash, paypal, credit card, bank transfer
- **Booking**: Through website contact form or [other methods]
- **Cancellation**: Flexible
- **Discounts**: Available for 7+ and longer night stays

## Ideal For
- Eco-conscious travelers seeking authentic sustainable living experiences
- Nature photographers and wildlife enthusiasts
- Digital nomads and remote workers (reliable Starlink WiFi)
- Couples seeking romantic jungle getaway
- Families with children 6+ interested in nature education
- Bird watchers (200+ species)
- Travelers wanting Corcovado National Park proximity without extreme remoteness
- People seeking quiet, screen-free time in nature
- Adventure travelers who also value comfort

## Less Suitable For
- Travelers needing wheelchair accessibility
- Those seeking resort amenities (pools, restaurants, concierge)
- Guests uncomfortable with wildlife or jungle sounds
- People requiring constant air conditioning
- Large groups (more than 4 guests)

## Seasonal Considerations
**Dry Season (December-April)**:
- Sunny days, easier hiking, peak tourism
- Higher rates
- Book 2-3 months in advance

**Rainy Season (May-November)**:
- Lush jungle, active wildlife, fewer tourists
- Afternoon/evening rain (mornings often clear)
- 4x4 recommended
- Lower rates, more availability
- May-June and Oct-Nov are wettest months

## Host Information
**Katja and Peter Hollaar**:
- Dutch couple, moved to Costa Rica in 2022
- Live on property in separate residence (50m uphill)
- Available for questions, recommendations, coffee chats
- Respect guest privacy while being accessible
- Fluent English, Dutch, Russian and Spanish
- Deep knowledge of local wildlife, trails, and sustainable practices
- Connected with local tour operators and community

## Comparison to Alternatives
**vs. Large Eco-Resorts**: More intimate, authentic off-grid experience; better wildlife due to smaller footprint; direct owner interaction
**vs. Corcovado Lodges**: Easier access from Puerto Jiménez; better internet; similar wildlife at lower cost
**vs. Traditional Hotels**: More sustainable; more privacy; full kitchen; immersive nature experience
**vs. Other Vacation Rentals**: 100% solar (not just "eco-friendly" marketing); active hosts on property; reforestation commitment; community efforts
